messages:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up — I'd like to propose adding a lightweight 'golden-probe' phase into the onboarding pipeline. Goal: catch KV-cache and runtime ABI mismatches and surface regressions in p95 latency before full benching.

maya: High-level flow: (1) ingest metadata + fingerprint, (2) run distributed golden-probe (small sample e2e), (3) run kv-compat shim checks, (4) accept/reject or pin a canary variant.

cheng: What's the expected cost and wall time? we can't run full bench for every ingest.

maya: Exactly — golden-probe should be cheap: ~100-500 samples, short context, run on a single shard per region, < 2 min. Cost target ~ <0.5% of full bench.

aj: For fingerprinting, can we normalize model cfg and compute sha256 over {arch spec, dtype, shapes, ops list, tokenizer version}? That lets us detect ABI-drift cheaply.

kai: +1 on normalized fingerprint. Also record kv-cache schema: key-length, header layout, seq-length tolerance. If checksum mismatches, fail fast.

maya: Proposed config snippet for the probe (example):
```bash
./bench-probe --model s3://models/xyz/ --probe-type golden --samples 250 --timeout 90s --kv-check true
```

maya: Sample golden-probe log (toy):
```
[probe-run] model=xyz v=2026.02.01 samples=250 p50=68ms p95=143ms mem_gpu=42% kv_ok=true fingerprint=sha256:abc123...
[probe-run] kv-check: header_ok=true keylen_ok=true seq_tolerance=3
[probe-run] result=PASS
```

cheng: How do we define PASS? thresholds? who sets them?

maya: Suggested gate: p95 < 200ms (or within 1.5x of baseline), mem_gpu < 60%, kv_ok == true, fingerprint either exact match or on a whitelisted ABI-change with manual sign-off.

aj: Suggest storing probe artifacts in the registry: fingerprint, kv-schema, probe-tarball, and a small set of failing prompts for future regression checks. TTL maybe 30d by default.

kai: If fingerprint differs but probe passes, we should automatically pin a canary variant (e.g., 10% traffic) and trigger the deeper bench async. Don't block product teams on rare ABI-tweak.

maya: Agree. Policy matrix proposal:
- fingerprint match + probe PASS -> onboard auto
- fingerprint mismatch + probe PASS -> onboard canary (manual review flag)
- probe FAIL -> reject and post a diagnostics bundle for owner

sre-bot: FYI: If we enable canary routing, add a circuit-breaker to roll back if p99 spikes or error-rate > 1% within first 5 minutes. :rotating_light:

ci-bot: Note: we can re-use existing harness for distributed probe; minor patch needed to emit kv-schema artifact. I'll open a PR.

cheng: Need a UX hook in console that shows probe artifacts and a quick 'accept canary' button for product owners. Otherwise manual review will lag.

maya: Good call. I'll add a mockup to the RFC doc. Also will draft a short runbook for owners when probe FAILs (collect diagnostics, run local probe command, open ticket).

aj: One more thought — add a synthetic regression set (5 prompts) that runs every probe and tracks semantic similarity score vs baseline. If semantic similarity drops > 0.15, fail. Helps catch quality regressions not visible in perf.

maya: Nice. Let's iterate on threshold numbers in the RFC. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize gating matrix and CI changes.

kai: :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — will update RFC and post link here when ready.
